title: Cassandra: Enabling Reasoning LLMs at Edge via Self-Speculative Decoding
selection_reason: The abstract proposes training-free self-speculative decoding for low-batch edge inference, using pruning and mantissa truncation for draft generation and hardware support to reduce conversion overhead; it reports up to 2.41x speedup and more tokens per memory budget.
